mapper.select: SELECT b.user_id, b.battle_id, b.stage_id, b.pf_id, b.total_damage, b.status, b.created_at, s.title as stage_title, s.job_category FROM battle b LEFT JOIN stage s ON b.stage_id = s.stage_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.battle_id = #{battleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO battle (user_id, battle_id, stage_id, pf_id, total_damage, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{battleId}, #{stageId}, #{pfId}, #{totalDamage}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(battle_id) FROM battle WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM battle WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND battle_id = #{battleId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.job_category FROM battle b JOIN stage s ON b.stage_id = s.stage_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.job_category
